frequently_asked_questions.question: Can I share the client portal with my couples without them seeing other clients' details?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes! EverAfter OS is built with a dedicated Client Portal template that is completely separate from your master internal databases, ensuring complete privacy and security for your agency data.

frequently_asked_questions.question: How does the mobile view work for assistants on-site on wedding days?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: We have designed a dedicated, high-contrast 'Day-of Command Center' view optimized specifically for the Notion mobile app. Assistants can easily view timelines, tap vendor phone numbers to call them directly, and check off cues on the move.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Is this template suitable for single-planner businesses, or is it only for teams?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: While it is designed to handle team assignments and shifts for boutique agencies, solo planners will find immense value in the advanced organization, professional client portal, and financial tracking features.
